intro: Sthuthiye Na Aayudham is the Telugu version of the popular English song, Raise A Hallelujah released by Bethel Music featuring Jonathan and Melissa Helser on January 03, 2019. This was translated and sung by Pastor Hannah Vimal featuring pastor Enosh Kumar, Samy Pachigalla, Benny Joshua & pastor Sundi Balasundaram Paul and music composed by Rahul. This song video was released on March 19, 2022 through Hannah Vimal YouTube channel.
